example_en: She blinked when the light fell on her.

definition: the leguminous tree Tamarindus indica of Caesalpiniaceae family; tamarind.
example: ಹುಣಚಿ ಮರದ ಬುಡದಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಹಾವಿನ ಹೊಳ್ಳವಿತ್ತು.
example_en: There was a snake hole at the base of the tamarind tree.

definition: an act characterised by great force, impetuosity or strong passion; vehemence.
example_en: Suddenly a vehement commotion began in the crowd.

definition: closeness; proximity.
example: ಅವರ ಮನೆಗಳ ನಡುವೆ ಇರುವ ಸನ್ನಿಕರ್ಷ ಸ್ನೇಹಕ್ಕೆ ಕಾರಣವಾಯಿತು.
example_en: The proximity between their houses became the cause of friendship.

definition: the tree Saymida febrifuga of Miliaceae family; bastard cedar; Indian redwood.
example: ಗೋರಖಮುಂಡಿ ಮತ್ತು ಲಿಂಬಾರ ಒಂದೇ ಜಾತಿಯ ಮರಗಳು.
example_en: The bastard cedar and the limbar are trees of the same species.

definition: a woman who has the tendency to talk lightly on any or various subjects.
example_en: That chatterbox woman used to spend her time chatting with neighbours.

definition: a pleasure garden or orchard.
example_en: There was a beautiful pleasure garden behind the palace.

definition: name of a petty goddess.
example_en: The village elders bowed to the goddess Badumbe.

definition: the plant Chrysanthemum indicum ( = Pyrethrum cinerariaefolium) of Asteraceae family; chrysanthemum plant.
example: ಅಜ್ಜಿ ಮನೆಯ ಮುಂದೆ ಶಾವಂತಿಗೆ ಗಿಡವನ್ನು ನೆಟ್ಟಿದ್ದಳು.
example_en: Grandmother had planted a chrysanthemum plant in front of the house.

definition: a descending; coming down or going down; descent.
example_en: The descent into the mine proceeded very slowly.

definition: a native or inhabitant of Europe; an European.
example_en: Many Europeans lived in that city.

definition: widely but unfavorably known or talked about; notorious.
example: ಆ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರಿಯ ಖ್ಯಾತಗರ್ಹಣ ವರ್ತನೆ ಊರಿನಲ್ಲೆಲ್ಲ ಸುದ್ದಿಯಾಯಿತು.
example_en: That merchant's notoriously disreputable conduct became the talk of the town.

definition: the ground beneath one's feet.
example_en: He stood barefoot on the ground beneath his feet.

definition: the creator of the universe.
example: ವಿಶ್ವಕರ್ಮ ಈ ಜಗತ್ತನ್ನು ಸೃಷ್ಟಿಸಿದನೆಂದು ನಂಬಿಕೆ ಇದೆ.
example_en: It is believed that the creator of the universe made this world.

definition: a singing by many people together in a musical show; a group-singing; chorus.
example_en: In the music program everyone sang together in a chorus.

definition: to wander or roam about.
example_en: He wandered about aimlessly for a long time.

definition: an act or instance of cheating; a deceiving.
example_en: Everyone was shocked when his act of cheating came to light.

definition: a channel in which water is running.
example_en: Water is flowing in the channel beside the field.

definition: the quandrangle of a temple, school, etc.
example_en: People had gathered in the quadrangle of the temple.

definition: the quality or fact of being hollow at the centre or inside; hollowness.
example_en: The hollowness at the center of that tree's trunk was noticed.

definition: finely ground meal of grain as wheat, rice, etc.; flour.
example: ಆ ಹಳ್ಳಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಜೋಳದ ಹಿಟು ಬಹಳ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ.
example_en: In that village, corn flour is very famous.

definition: a woman who has received (good) education.
example_en: She is an educated woman, working in a good job.

definition: high polish; brightness; lustre.
example: ಆ ಬಂಗಾರದ ಆಭರಣಕ್ಕೆ ಒಳ್ಳೆಯ ಮೆರುಗು ಇದೆ.
example_en: That gold ornament has a fine lustre.

definition: to turn from a direct line or course or from being a straight line.
example_en: The wind blew and turned the creeper aside from its straight line.

definition: to labour, perform service and get salary, wages, etc.; to earn.
example: ಅವನು ಕಷ್ಟಪಟ್ಟು ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡಿ ಹಣ ಗೞಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: He worked hard and earned money.

definition: pertaining to civil matters; that is to be dealt under civil laws.
example: ಇದು ದಿವಾನಿ ಮೊಕದ್ದಮೆ ಎಂದು ನ್ಯಾಯಾಲಯ ಹೇಳಿತು.
example_en: The court said this is a civil case.

definition: a clear, shrill sound made by whistling or blowing a whistle.
example: ಬೀದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅವನ ಸೀಳು ಕೇಳಿ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ತಿರುಗಿ ನೋಡಿದರು.
example_en: Everyone turned to look on hearing his whistle in the street.

definition: this side or region.
example_en: The one standing on this side is my elder brother.

definition: a group of people, animals or things; a multitude; a bundle.
example_en: A group of deer moved together through the forest.

definition: a reciting of the vedas aloud.
example_en: The priests recited the vedas aloud in the morning.

definition: to remove by cutting out or away; to excise.
example_en: The doctors excised the tumour through surgery.

definition: any of the larger marine mammals of the order Cetacea, esp. as distinguished from the smaller dolphins and porpoises, having a fishlike body, forelimbs modified into flippers, and a head that is horizontally flattened; a whale.
example_en: A huge whale was swimming in the sea.

definition: lustre, brightness; brilliance; splendour.
example_en: The brilliance of that diamond was dazzling to the eyes.

definition: revenue of a government got from imposing fines on offenders and violators.
example_en: The officials recorded the fine revenue.

definition: to come forth into view; become visible; to emerge.
example_en: The moon emerged into view amid the clouds.

definition: an ostentatious display; an empty show to draw attention; vanity; ostentation.
example_en: People laugh when they see his ostentatious display.

definition: a collective interview granted to media personnel as by a celebrity or personage.
example_en: The chief minister held a press conference.

definition: the diety presiding over the plot on which a building is to be constructed.
example_en: Before the house-warming they offered worship to the deity of the building plot.

definition: anything that is in extreme degree.
example_en: The extreme force of the wind blew off the house's roof.

definition: small-minded or ignoble; mean; abject; despicable.
example_en: Nobody appreciates his mean, ignoble behaviour.

definition: a feeling of displeasure and belligerence aroused by a wrong; anger.
example: ಅನ್ಯಾಯದ ಮಾತು ಕೇಳಿ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಮುನಿಸು ಉಂಟಾಯಿತು.
example_en: Hearing the unjust words, he felt anger.

definition: to cause to feel fright; to scare; to terrify; to frighten.
example_en: That frightening sound scared the children.

definition: a long, narrow strip of cloth tied to the bottom corner of a kite for maintaining the balance when flown in the air.
example_en: We tied a tail-string to the kite to maintain its balance.

definition: a stormy, turbulent or very noise condition (as created by unruly mob); commotion.
example_en: A noisy commotion started in the meeting due to a quarrel.

definition: a button having two parts that fastens two ends of a cloth when pressed together; a press -button.
example_en: He had fastened a press-button on his shirt.

definition: to cause to split or crack sharply or break into pieces; to smash; to shatter.
example: ಕೋಪದಿಂದ ಅವನು ಮಡಕೆಯನ್ನು ನೆಲಕ್ಕೆ ಬಡಿದು ಒಡೆಮುಱಿದನು.
example_en: In anger he struck the pot on the ground and shattered it.

definition: to cause to cut, amputate or slay.
example_en: He got the carpenter to cut the wood.

definition: a drawn or painted, picture of a person; a portrait.
example_en: There was a portrait of the father on the wall.

definition: to gather information through observations, questionnaires, etc., study critically and analyse it; to survey.
example_en: The researchers surveyed people's opinions.

definition: a bad, undecipherable hand-writing; cocography.
example_en: The doctor's writing was as hard to read as an undecipherable scrawl.

definition: a man of strong will or volition.
example_en: That man of strong will never yielded to difficulties.

definition: maintenance of peace, law and order.
example_en: The police are maintaining peace and law and order in the town.

definition: a Christian priest; a padre.
example_en: The priest conducted the prayer in the church.

definition: affliction; mental anguish.
example: ಮಗನ ಅಗಲಿಕೆ ತಾಯಿಗೆ ತೀವ್ರ ಮನೋಗ್ಲಾನಿ ಉಂಟುಮಾಡಿತು.
example_en: The son's separation caused severe mental anguish to the mother.

definition: an eye-disease.
example: ಅಯ್ರಿ ಕಾಣಿಸಿಕೊಂಡ ಮೇಲೆ ಅವನ ಕಣ್ಣು ಕೆಂಪಾಯಿತು.
example_en: After the eye-disease appeared, his eyes turned red.

definition: an irrelevant, arrogant or haughty reply.
example_en: The arrogant, irrelevant reply he gave angered everyone.

definition: a sharp, probing look.
example_en: She gave me a sharp, probing look.

definition: a deep, wide pit for the capture of wild elephants.
example_en: The hunters dug a pit-trap for the elephants.

definition: a farmer; an agriculturist.
example_en: That farmer was working in the paddy field.

definition: twice as much, as many or as large; double.
example: ಈ ಮನೆಯ ಬೆಲೆ ಆ ಮನೆಗಿಂತ ದುಹೇರವಾಗಿದೆ.
example_en: The price of this house is double that of that house.

definition: made clear; explained lucidly; elucidated.
example_en: The teacher explained the lesson lucidly.

definition: requested; prayed; beseeched.
example_en: The teacher accepted his requested plea.

definition: to cut into pieces; to mince.
example_en: The cook had the onion minced finely.

definition: to be uneasy, anxious.
example_en: The mother became anxious when the child did not come.

definition: suddenly; all of a sudden; unexpectedly.
example_en: He suddenly got up and ran away.

definition: to join (oneself) with another or others.
example_en: He joined himself with his friends.

definition: to become available; to be got, obtained.
example_en: He obtained a good job.

definition: to flow or spread beyond the limits; to overflow.
example: ಮಳೆಗೆ ಕೆರೆಯ ನೀರು ಸಂಪ್ಲವಿಸಿ ರಸ್ತೆಗೆ ಹರಿಯಿತು.
example_en: Due to the rain, the lake water overflowed and spread onto the road.

definition: (a bull) to roar with a powerful, reverberating sound; to moo; to bellow.
example_en: The bull bellowed in the cowshed.

definition: to remove or discharge from the duty, office, position or employment; to dismiss.
example_en: The governing board dismissed him from the post.

definition: a pile of stones.
example_en: A pile of stones was stacked by the roadside.

definition: to snub another down with movement of one's eyes or brows.
example_en: The teacher snubbed the class with a movement of her eyes and made them quiet.

definition: any of various plant diseases caused or spread by flies.
example_en: A fly-borne plant disease ruined the garden crop.

definition: to fix an object as a target (to hit, shoot, at).
example_en: He took aim at the sparrow and shot the arrow.

definition: to cause to tie with a wire or wires.
example_en: The craftsman joined the two pieces by having them tied with wire.

definition: to exact punishment or expiation for a wrong on behalf of, esp. in a resentful or vindictive spirit.
example: ಶತ್ರುಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ಸೇಡು ತೀರಿಸಲು ಅವನು ನೆಪ್ಪುಗೊಂಡನು.
example_en: He exacted vengeance on his enemies to settle the score.

definition: that with which something is covered, veiled; a veil.
example_en: She covered her face with a veil (huduga).

definition: having no boundaries; shoreless.
example: ಸಮುದ್ರದ ಅಪ್ಪಾರ ವಿಸ್ತಾರ ನೋಡಿ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಬೆರಗಾಯಿತು.
example_en: He was amazed to see the shoreless expanse of the sea.

definition: a thin, long plank of wood.
example_en: The carpenter made a door from the plank of wood.

definition: a smiling face.
example_en: The teacher gave the students prizes with a smiling face.

definition: a ray of light.
example_en: The ray of the lamp pierced through the darkness.

definition: to cover, daub with or rub oil or ointment on.
example_en: She daubed ointment on the wound.

definition: a unripe fruit; a fruit in the very initial stage of development.
example_en: The unripe fruit fell from the tree and was spoiled.

definition: to begin; to start; to take up (an engagement, work, charge, etc.).
example_en: The officer took up the new charge.

definition: one of the prominent cities in Karnāṭaka, former capital of the princely state Mysūru.
example_en: The city of Mysore is famous for its palaces.

definition: an abnormality or difficulty in digesting food, dyspepsia; indigestion.
example: ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಎಣ್ಣೆಯ ಆಹಾರ ಸೇವಿಸಿದ್ದರಿಂದ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಅರ್ಕಮೆ ಉಂಟಾಯಿತು.
example_en: Because he ate too much oily food, he got indigestion.

definition: a track of marshy land (where reeds grow abundantly).
example: ಆ ನಳ್ಳುನೆಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಜೊಂಡು ಹುಲ್ಲು ದಟ್ಟವಾಗಿ ಬೆಳೆದಿತ್ತು.
example_en: Reeds had grown densely in that marshy land.

definition: any act regarded as such a transgression, esp. a willful or deliberate violation of some religious or moral principle; a sin.
example: ಸುಳ್ಳು ಹೇಳುವುದು ಪಾಪ ಎಂದು ಅಮ್ಮ ಹೇಳಿದಳು.
example_en: Mother said that telling lies is a sin.

definition: the act or fact of leaving one country or one region to settle in another; emigration.
example_en: After emigration, their life changed.

definition: a game in which a small piece of wood, usu. tapered at both ends, is struck on one end with a bat or stick so that it is flipped into the air, where it can be batted for distance; tipcat.
example_en: The children were playing tipcat in the street.

definition: the chief of an army; a military commander.
example_en: The king's army commander led the troops.

definition: that which is of or, having to do with the latest styles, methods or ideas or that which is designated to certain contemporary trends and schools of art, music, literature, dance, etc.
example_en: This painting reflects the contemporary style.

definition: the beginning of anything; a coming into existence.
example: ಈ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಯ ಪೊದಳ್ಕೆ ಒಂದು ಸಣ್ಣ ಅಂಗಡಿಯಿಂದ ಆಯಿತು.
example_en: The beginning of this institution came from a small shop.

definition: the quality of a person who is cruel; cruelty.
example_en: That king's cruelty had frightened the subjects.

definition: any compact, hard sedimentary rock composed mainly of clay materials; clay stone; argillaceous rock.
example_en: Claystone is abundant in the soil of that region.

definition: drill - a) military or physical training, esp. of a group, as in marching, the manual of arms or gymnastic exercises b) a single exercise in such training.
example_en: The soldiers do drill every morning.

definition: that which is at the back of.
example_en: There was a small garden at the back of the house.

definition: (a liquid) to fall in drops; to drop.
example: ಮಳೆ ನಿಂತ ಮೇಲೂ ಮರದಿಂದ ನೀರು ಹನಿಕುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: Even after the rain stopped, water kept dropping from the tree.

definition: the household works a house-keeper.
example_en: The mother taught her daughter household work.

definition: a two-masted sailing ship that is square-rigged except for fore-and-aft mainsail; a brigantine.
example_en: The brigantine was anchored in the harbour.

definition: to flow in stream.
example_en: The mountain brook flowed with a murmuring sound.

definition: (fig.) a tying or being tied securely.
example_en: Everyone was frightened by the tight grip of his words.

definition: to initiate talking on a topic, subject.
example_en: He initiated talk about politics.

definition: a flat, wide, plate made intertwining thin bamboo splits.
example: ಅಜ್ಜಿ ಹಡಲಿಗೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಬಾಳೆಹಣ್ಣು ಇಟ್ಟು ಒಣಗಿಸಿದಳು.
example_en: The grandmother dried the bananas by placing them on the bamboo plate.

definition: very generous in giving; characterised by great generosity; generous; munificent; liberal; benevolent.
example: ಆ ಶ್ರೀಮಂತ ಬಡವರಿಗೆ ಉದಾರವಾಗಿ ದಾನ ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: That rich man generously donated to the poor.

definition: a degrading or being degraded in rank, status or condition; degradation.
example_en: After the defeat, he suffered a degradation in status.

definition: a set of two similar, corresponding or complementary things that make a pair.
example: ಆ ಎರಡು ಪಾತ್ರೆಗಳು ಒಂದೇ ಸವಳಿಗೆ ಸೇರಿದವು.
example_en: Those two vessels belong to the same matching pair.

definition: the imaginary circle drawn parallel to the equator at c. 66º 34' south of it; the antarctic circle.
example_en: The antarctic circle is in the southern part of the earth.

definition: the act of greeting, saluting with both the palms joined together.
example: ಅವನು ಗುರುವನ್ನು ಕಂಡು ಕೈಮುಗಿಹ ಮಾಡಿ ನಮಸ್ಕರಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: Seeing his teacher, he greeted him with joined palms and bowed.

definition: a sham-quarrel between lovers.
example_en: Their playful lovers' quarrel made everyone laugh.

definition: the cat-like carnivorous mammal Paradoxurus hermapharodatus; toddy-cat; palm civet.
example_en: The palm civet moves about on trees at night.

definition: a person who goes before, preparing the way for others, setting the pattern, as an early settler or a scientist doing exploratory work; a pioneer.
example: ಆ ಊರಿನ ಆದಿಗ ಈ ಪ್ರದೇಶವನ್ನು ಮೊದಲು ಬೆಳೆಸಿದನು.
example_en: The pioneer of that village first developed this region.

definition: to cause (a person) to remember; to remind.
example_en: The mother reminded her son of his promise.

definition: to step backward; to go back.
example_en: Seeing the snake, he stepped backward.

definition: any of the front teeth that is broad like the blade of a hoe.
example_en: The boy's broad front tooth was clearly visible.

definition: a person not liable to change or who is dispassionate.
example: ಆ ಸಂತ ಅವಿಕಾರಿಯಾಗಿ ಎಲ್ಲ ಕಷ್ಟಗಳನ್ನೂ ಎದುರಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: That saint, being dispassionate, faced all hardships.

definition: to shine brightly.
example_en: The night lights shone brightly in the city.

definition: the condition or feeling of being afraid; fear; fright.
example: ಸಿಂಹದ ಗರ್ಜನೆ ಕೇಳಿ ಮಕ್ಕಳಿಗೆ ದಿಗಿಲು ಉಂಟಾಯಿತು.
example_en: Hearing the lion's roar, the children felt fright.

definition: (gram.) the euphonic junction of two are more consonants.
example_en: The teacher taught the rules of consonant sandhi.

definition: an animal skin or pelt, either raw or tanned; hide.
example_en: The hunter hung the hide on the wall to dry.

definition: an inadvertent talk.
example: ಸಭೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬಾಯಿತಪ್ಪಿನಿಂದ ಆಡಿದ ಮಾತಿಗೆ ಅವನು ಕ್ಷಮೆ ಕೇಳಿದನು.
example_en: He apologized for the words spoken inadvertently in the meeting.

definition: to shine brilliantly.
example_en: The gold ornament was shining brilliantly in the sunlight.

definition: a respite from studying; intermission of study.
example: ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯ ನಂತರ ಒಂದು ವಾರ ಅನಧ್ಯಯನ ಇರುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: There is a week's intermission of study after the exam.

definition: a slip or sheet of paper or the like, on which a voter marks his or her vote; a ballot.
example: ಮತದಾರ ಮತಚೀಟಿಯ ಮೇಲೆ ತನ್ನ ಆಯ್ಕೆಯ ಗುರುತು ಹಾಕಿದನು.
example_en: The voter marked his choice on the ballot slip.

definition: to stab with a dagger.
example_en: The thieves stabbed the guard with a dagger and ran away.

definition: pertaining to more than one country; international (dif. from a ntardēśīya); not confined to a single country.
example_en: This matter has gained international importance.

definition: a type of drama usu. enacted in open.
example_en: The villagers performed the open-air drama in the field.

definition: a loose mixture of pebbles and rock fragments coarser than sand, often mixed with clay, etc.; gravel; grit.
example_en: Gravel and grit lay heaped on the bank of the stream.

definition: to take off; to remove (as dress, outer covering etc.).
example_en: Take off the hat in the sun.

definition: a pregnant woman.
example_en: The pregnant woman was waiting for her baby.

definition: an undomesticated cat; Felis catus; wild-cat.
example_en: The wild-cat hunts at night in the forest.

definition: to become unreasonably unyielding, obstinate.
example_en: He became obstinately unyielding and would not admit his mistake.

definition: to erase or destroy completely.
example_en: He erased the old writings completely.

definition: a written document for having debited another's account; a debit note.
example_en: The bank sent him a debit note.

definition: the act of striking; a stroke; a heavy blow.
example_en: The enemy's heavy blow fell upon his back.

definition: rinsed (said of the mouth).
example_en: His mouth had been rinsed before the worship.

definition: the state of being associated; companionship; fellowship; association
example_en: Their companionship has continued for many years.

definition: a red limestone that is soft and can easily be pulverised; red-chalk.
example: ಚಿತ್ರಕಾರ ಗೋಡೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಕಲ್ಮದದಿಂದ ರೇಖೆ ಎಳೆದನು.
example_en: The painter drew a line on the wall with red-chalk.

definition: a native provincial deputy or governor of the old Mogul Empire; a nawab.
example: ಇತಿಹಾಸದಲ್ಲಿ ಆ ನವಾಬು ದಕ್ಷ ಆಡಳಿತಗಾರನೆಂದು ಹೆಸರುವಾಸಿಯಾಗಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: In history, that nawab was famed as an efficient administrator.

definition: a state of mental distress; worry.
example: ಮಗ ಮನೆಗೆ ಬಾರದಿದ್ದಾಗ ಅಮ್ಮನಿಗೆ ಪಿಕಲಾಟ ಶುರುವಾಯಿತು.
example_en: When the son did not come home, the mother's worry began.

definition: to shake or tremble severely.
example_en: During the earthquake, the whole house shook severely.

definition: a woman who is afflicted, vexed, tormented.
example_en: She became an afflicted woman due to her husband's separation.

definition: the need for, and the discomfort, pain caused by a need for, food; hunger.
example: ಬೆಳಗ್ಗೆ ಎದ್ದ ಕೂಡಲೇ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಹಸಿವೆ ಆಯಿತು.
example_en: He felt hungry as soon as he woke up in the morning.

definition: a low voice.
example_en: The grandmother told the story in a low voice.

definition: a journey made to a shrine or holy place; pilgrimage.
example: ಭಕ್ತರು ಪ್ರತಿ ವರ್ಷ ತಿರುಪತಿಗೆ ಜಾತ್ರೆ ಹೋಗುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: Devotees make a pilgrimage to Tirupati every year.

definition: to burn by fire or heat.
example_en: Hot water burns the hand.

definition: an institution of higher education that grants degrees, as a bacheloṛs degree, being a division of a university; a college.
example_en: She joined college this year.

definition: a latticework, having vines grown over; a bower; an arbour.
example: ಮನೆಯ ಮುಂದೆ ಬಳ್ಳಿಮಾಡ ನಿರ್ಮಿಸಿ ಹೂಬಳ್ಳಿ ಬೆಳೆಸಿದರು.
example_en: They built a bower in front of the house and grew flowering vines.

definition: a prolonged or serious shortage or deficiency, caused by a prolonged period of dry weather; drought; famine.
example: ಈ ವರ್ಷ ಮಳೆ ಇಲ್ಲದೆ ಊರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಡಾವರ ಉಂಟಾಯಿತು.
example_en: With no rain this year, drought struck the village.

definition: a son of one's grandson or grand daughter.
example_en: Grandfather picked up his great-grandson and played with him.

definition: (dial.) free and intimate behavior; absence of formality and ceremony; mamiliarity.
example: ಅವರಿಬ್ಬರ ನಡುವೆ ಫುಸಲತ್ತು ಇದ್ದುದರಿಂದ ಯಾವ ಸಂಕೋಚವೂ ಇರಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: Because there was free and intimate familiarity between the two of them, there was no hesitation at all.

definition: to take out.
example_en: He took the money out of his pocket.

definition: any severe physical or mental pain; agony; anguish; torture.
example: ಆ ಕೈದಿಗೆ ಜೈಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಬಹಳ ಹಿಂಸೆ ಆಯಿತು.
example_en: That prisoner suffered great torture in the jail.

definition: lack of attention; carelessness.
example_en: The work got ruined because of his carelessness.

definition: the cardinal number thirty; 30.
example_en: There are thirty houses in that village.

definition: standard pieces of gold, silver, copper, nickel, etc., stamped by government authority and used as a medium of exchange and measure of value; money.
example_en: He has accumulated plenty of money.

definition: the act or an instance of deceiving; a deceiving or lying; deceit.
example_en: The customers came to know of the merchant's deceit.

definition: Mallikārjuna, a form of Śiva.
example_en: Girimalla is worshipped at Srisailam.

definition: (collectively) seedlings raised for transplantation.
example_en: The farmers prepared seedlings for transplantation.

definition: an ornament worn as a token of a title.
example_en: He wore that ornament as a token of his title.

definition: sensuous enjoyments.
example_en: He was immersed in sensuous enjoyments and forgot righteousness.

definition: goods that are sold in relatively large quantities; wholesale merchandise.
example_en: He trades in wholesale merchandise.

definition: burning ablaze.
example_en: The fire was burning ablaze.

definition: the act of painting, decorating with a paint or paints.
example_en: The artist did the painting on the wall.

definition: to face in confrontation; to oppose.
example: ಆ ಸೈನಿಕ ಶತ್ರುವಿನ ಎದುರು ಅಡ್ಡಾನಿ ನಿಂತನು.
example_en: That soldier stood confronting the enemy.

definition: the ancient cultivated rose plant, Rosa centifolia of Rosaceae family, ancestor of many modern roses; cabbage rose plant.
example_en: The cabbage rose plant bloomed beautifully in the garden.

definition: (pl.) four directions.
example_en: People had come to the fair from all four directions.

definition: the belief or doctrine that there is only one God; monotheism.
example_en: Monotheism is a fundamental principle of many religions.

definition: a slandering remark; slander.
example: ಅವನ ಕೊಂಡೆಯ ಮಾತು ಇಬ್ಬರ ಸ್ನೇಹ ಕೆಡಿಸಿತು.
example_en: His slandering remark spoiled the friendship between the two.

definition: made of bamboo (or its splits).
example_en: They placed the fruits in the bamboo basket.

definition: the evergreen tree Alstonia scholaris of Apocynaceae family.
example: ಊರ ಮಧ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ದೊಡ್ಡ ಏಳೆಲೆಬಾಳೆ ಮರ ನೆರಳು ನೀಡುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: A large Alstonia scholaris tree in the middle of the town was giving shade.

definition: too numerous to be counted; countless; innumerable.
example_en: Countless stars twinkled in the sky.

definition: a loud, a rumbling or roaring sound.
example_en: A rumbling roar of clouds was heard in the sky.

definition: the site of a war; a battle-field.
example_en: The soldiers lost their lives on the battle-field.

definition: that bites or stings.
example_en: That biting insect stings the cattle.

definition: a dark-brown or black mineral of the mica family, found in igneous and metamorphic rocks; biotite.
example_en: Biotite can be seen in the soil.

definition: swallowed; eaten; consumed.
example_en: The parrot swallowed and consumed the grain.

definition: to make an attempt; to try earnestly.
example_en: She tried earnestly to succeed in the exam.

definition: the place or region behind.
example_en: There is a tree in the backyard of the house.

definition: a man of crooked nature.
example_en: Do not believe the words of a crooked man.

definition: the act, fact or manner of questioning, inquiring; a questioning; an inquiry.
example_en: The disciple's inquiry brought joy to the teacher.

definition: cat, as the enemy of rat.
example_en: The cat, the rat's enemy, chases rats.

definition: a man who has expert knowledge in artistic quality, ability or work and keen discrimination in art; a connoisseur.
example_en: The connoisseur's words became guidance for the artists.
